statement: The box around the bike is large enough for the flow and the wake

mechanism.how: aero.domain measures the body with OpenFOAM's surfaceCheck and the box with the blockMeshDict, against COST 732 (Franke et al. 2007) in heights of the body: inlet, sides and top at least 5 H, outlet at least 15 H, blockage at most 3%
